…I finally got around to listening to the song.

Now I want peaches.

I remember when I was in elementary school there was this fruit option in the cafeteria that was basically preserved peach chunks in a plastic cup, but it was great because they tended to be half-frozen and they were the best things ever during the summer. Rest of the food options were pretty gross, but I remember those icy peach chunks very fondly for some reason.

Peaches, peaches for me…

item.title: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
So, this is something I’ve been working on for awhile. It started as scraps of notebook paper I’d write on when I got dragged to awkward family events and waiting in lines and stuff, thinking about how the Foundation handles staff stress and burnout. I never really grew out of having imaginary friends, instead they grew up with me, and I like to think about how they react to different scenarios similar to my experiences.

Riven is not good at the relax. Mark is good at the relax because it’s part of the job description.

Many, many thanks to people in chat:

  • LordStonefish for saying the tale is "the equivalent of cotton candy"
  • minmin for grammar/punctuation/flow/making things sound good edits even this isn’t your kind of tale
  • Jekeled for the wordings
  • Woggle also for the wordings, and commenting on feel of the piece
  • Tuomey for reading, even though sleep deprived
  • MacLeod for commenting on tea mug measurement of work completion and “zen, chill-as-fuck” style
  • AidenEldritch for commentary on characters, Wiven is a doctor now yes ;-; they grow up so fast
  • Quikngruvn for telling me to post it, and for coming up with the title
  • thermal, The_xenomorph666, for reading in chat
  • anyone I've forgotten to mention, please let me know and I will put you on the list because credit where it's due is important!1!!!!!11!
